mapper.select:
SELECT crm.cust_code , cst.cust_name , crm.credit_type , cod.code_name credit_type_name , crm.credit_max , crm.credit_due_day FROM tb_credit_master crm JOIN tb_cm_code cod ON (crm.credit_type = cod.code AND cod.group_code = 'CREDIT_TYPE') JOIN tb_cust_master cst ON (crm.cust_code = cst.cust_code AND crm.company_code = cst.company_code) WHERE 1=1
AND crm.cust_code like '%' || #{custCode} || '%'
AND cst.cust_name like '%' || #{custName} || '%'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO tb_credit_master crm USING (SELECT #{companyCode} company_code , #{custCode} cust_code , #{creditMax} credit_max , #{creditDueDay} credit_due_day , #{creditType} credit_type FROM dual) ins ON (crm.company_code = ins.company_code AND crm.cust_code = ins.cust_code AND crm.credit_type = ins.credit_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET crm.credit_max = ins.credit_max , crm.credit_due_day = ins.credit_due_day , crm.update_date = sysdate , crm.updated_by = 'ADMIN' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (company_code , cust_code , credit_type , credit_max , credit_due_day , create_date , created_by) VALUES (ins.company_code , ins.cust_code , ins.credit_type , ins.credit_max , ins.credit_due_day , sysdate , 'ADMIN')
